info.name: Consumer Complaint Database Aggregations CSV API

params.name: years
params.description: Comma-separated list of years (e.g. 2018,2019,2020)

params.name: actions_taken
params.description: Comma-separated list of action taken codes (1-8)

params.name: construction_methods
params.description: Comma-separated list of construction method codes (1=Site Built, 2=Manufactured)

params.name: derived_dwelling_categories
params.description: Comma-separated list of derived dwelling category codes

params.name: derived_loan_product_types
params.description: Comma-separated list of derived loan product type codes

params.name: ethnicities
params.description: Comma-separated list of ethnicity codes

params.name: lien_statuses
params.description: Comma-separated list of lien status codes (1=First lien, 2=Subordinate lien)

params.name: loan_purposes
params.description: Comma-separated list of loan purpose codes (1=Home purchase, 2=Home improvement, 31=Refinancing, 32=Cash-out refinancing, 4=Other purpose, 5=Not applicable)

params.name: loan_types
params.description: Comma-separated list of loan type codes (1=Conventional, 2=FHA, 3=VA, 4=FSA/RHS)

params.name: races
params.description: Comma-separated list of race codes

params.name: sexes
params.description: Comma-separated list of sex codes (1=Male, 2=Female, 3=Information not provided, 4=Not applicable)

items.docs: Returns a CSV download of HMDA data for the entire nation filtered by the specified variables.
